faq.description: Everything you need to know about running WhatsApp on WAGOAT.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions

refundPolicy.question: Does WAGOAT use the official WhatsApp API?
refundPolicy.answer: No. WAGOAT connects to the WhatsApp you already have, which lets us offer unlimited messages at a flat monthly price — no per-message costs and no template restrictions.

cancelSubscription.question: Will my number get banned?
cancelSubscription.answer: We take safety seriously with spintax, proxies and smart sending intervals to keep your numbers protected, and you stay in control of volume and pacing.

changePlan.question: Which CRM does WAGOAT work with?
changePlan.answer: WAGOAT connects your WhatsApp to GoHighLevel, syncing every conversation straight into your pipeline. You message customers from the CRM you already use.

freeTrial.question: Do you offer a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: Yes. You can try WAGOAT free for 7 days and cancel anytime.
